nodes.name: agentsview-lessons-orgtrack-session-analytics--0624.md
nodes.summary: Design note explaining how agentsview's parsing and analytics patterns were selectively folded into ORGII's existing orgtrack/unified_stats pipeline — adding prompt-cache-aware token accounting, a session heatmap endpoint, and a chat start-page Heat map tab — without introducing a parallel analytics system or database.

nodes.name: frontend-engines.md
nodes.summary: Architecture reference for the `src/engines/` subsystem: seven self-contained runtime engines (SessionCore, ChatPanel, Simulator, BrowserCore, TerminalCore, DatabaseCore, GitWorkflow), how they communicate via Jotai atoms, Tauri IPC, and events, and the conventions for isolating and adding a new engine.
nodes.languageNotes: Documents a deliberate no-cross-import isolation rule between engines, enforced only through Jotai atoms, Tauri IPC, and a lightweight event bus rather than the module boundary itself.

nodes.name: managed-cloud-collaboration.md
nodes.summary: Canonical design contract for ORGII's managed-cloud collaboration feature: the Personal/Organization/Link-capability scope model, backend-authoritative ownership and authorization, durable sync of Projects/Work Items via an SQLite outbox, comments and agent-task handling, presence, execution locks, desktop instance isolation, the backend migration contract, and the required verification gates.

nodes.name: rust-crates.md
nodes.summary: Comprehensive map of the Rust workspace under `src-tauri/` — a mermaid dependency graph plus per-domain descriptions of roughly 40 library crates (foundation, storage, VCS, agent runtime, IDE tooling, browser automation, system/platform, testing) and the responsibilities of the root `app` binary crate.
nodes.languageNotes: agent_core acts as an aggregator crate that most domain crates funnel into, with the app binary crate wiring Tauri command handlers via a generated handler_list.inc rather than exposing its own library API.

nodes.name: warp-imported-history.md
nodes.summary: Describes ORGII's read-only importer for Warp's locally stored Agent conversations: the SQLite/protobuf source contract, per-platform database discovery order, mapping of Warp events into ORGII replay chunks, metadata fallback rules, caching/compatibility handling, and privacy limitations.
